logos.attribution: Mapam; Shmuel Katz (poster designer); Central Zionist Archives KRA/3225. Crop from a dated official campaign publication, not a recreated emblem.
logos.inUseEvidence: CZA KRA/3225: exact catalogue year 1959 (not estimated), official Mapam campaign poster with issuer name and מ ballot roundel. 1959 had one Knesset election, 3 November. Year precision under decision 0089; the Jerusalem municipal advertising-tax stamp valid until 22 December 1959 is not a campaign date. Crop preserves original colours and the scan edge without redrawing.

dateEvidence.yearEvidence: CZA exhibition caption KRA/3225 explicitly gives 1959 without an estimate marker. The municipal advertising-tax stamp is not used to date campaign use.
dateEvidence.campaignEvidence: Party-issued election poster: printed issuer בהוצאת מפלגת הפועלים המאוחדת (מפ״ם) — האחראי: א. שריד; white מ ballot roundel; CZA caption describes the 1959 campaign. Stamp: עיריית ירושלים / מס פרסום מודעות / עד יום 22.XII.1959 / שולם. No Haifa imprint.
